reviews.review:
Other people are being too hard on this game. This is casual fun. In a nutshell:
If Fortnite had a single player baby this is what it would look like. Amazing deck experience with beautiful graphics and no tinkering needed. 💯 recommended if you like shooting at strange creatures and fast paced combat. Sure devs will keep updating the game (I hope) since it is awesome and needs a bit of polishing. Maybe we can get a campaign mode? 🙏🏻🙏🏻
not enough updates/improvements. i was looking for rouguelikes like risk of rain 2 and instabought this one along with gunfire reborn. I was COMPLETELY dissapointed with this one.
reviews.developer_response: We have just released a brand new content update today improving performance, adding missions, tweaking gameplay elements  & more. We hope you give the game another chance!
